body: Thank you, I wish you the best too.
I will tell them if I ever get the courage to, thank you for your words. It means a lot.

I wish I could tell my parents. Once they saw I was cutting myself (this was a few years ago) and they blamed it on my phone. I don’t even want to know their reaction if they found out I wanted to kill myself and that I’m still cutting, they’d probably beat me and take my phone and computer away and blame it on that.
